records.quote: Adjustments can happen at line, claim or provider level.
records.supports: Reconcile adjustment level and CARC/RARC context before labeling a loss.
records.limits: Medicare remittance guidance; not a determination of commercial contract recovery or a definition of the local denial cohort.

records.quote: Number of days to 3rd next available appointment
records.supports: Use an observed access outcome alongside capacity/process measures and balancing measures.
records.limits: Improvement guidance, not a regulatory requirement or validation of the tool's stable-demand clearance scenario.

records.quote: evaluates and certifies each participating hospital as a whole
records.supports: Survey applicability and institutional scope require qualified validation; a gap counter does not certify readiness.
records.limits: Medicare hospital certification overview, not a verified local finding, accreditor standard or all facility types.

records.quote: 120 days from the date of receipt
records.supports: Deadlines depend on program, notice and receipt convention; do not infer them from a generic case date.
records.limits: Original Medicare first-level claim redetermination example only. Its period is not a generic prior-authorization, Medicare Advantage or commercial appeal rule.

records.quote: each Medicare payment locality has a geographic practice cost index
records.supports: Expected payment requires the correct code, locality, applicable policy and authoritative effective payment source.
records.limits: Medicare physician fee schedule context only. No private contract amount, coding adjudication or collectible debt is established.

records.quote: Include the patient and family as full partners
records.supports: Retain patient/family participation and responsible clinical review in administrative discharge coordination.
records.limits: Patient/family engagement guidance; it does not define this hospital's avoidable days or authorize a discharge.

records.quote: Input representing the broad interests of the community
records.supports: A charitable hospital's CHNA interview plan needs public health, underserved/low-income/minority input and prior written comments.
records.limits: Section 501(r)(3) charitable hospital scope. This general review does not certify any hospital's CHNA compliance.
